scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.codegen: node scripts/generate-language-artifacts.mjs && biome check --write src/index.ts src/domain/language/catalog.ts src/domain/language/registry.ts
scripts.website:prepare: node scripts/ensure-website-data-dir.mjs && npm run build && npm run website:test && npm run website:bench && npm run website:data && biome format --write docs/data/*.json
scripts.website:test: node scripts/ensure-website-data-dir.mjs && vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=docs/data/unit-results.json && node scripts/summarize-website-tests.mjs
